newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strike ends at Air France Cargo CDG hub.
newsitem.headline: Strike ends at Air France Cargo CDG hub.

text.p: Warehousing staff at Air France Cargo's Paris-Charles de Gaulle freight handling centre have ended strike action in protest over a new wage structure, an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.

"The strike which began last Thursday afternoon (March 20) ended on Saturday (March 22) and the situation is now back to normal with the resumption cargo reservations this morning," the official said.
Several of Air France's Boeing 747-200 freighters had their scheduled departures delayed while at least one CDG-bound freighter was diverted because of the strike.
Air France's cargo handling activities at Paris-Orly airport were also affected by the strike.

"While the strike has been called off, the dispute is still under negotiation with the management. And for that reason there can't be any cast-iron guarantees of no further action," a union official said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
